name: 01-main-menus
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished high-resolution 2x2 board of FOUR complete widescreen game UI screens, each quadrant landscape 16:9, thin white gutters, no surrounding presentation decorations. Reference image 1 is the STRICT visual design system, not loose inspiration. Reproduce its exact rendered tactile look: deep royal-blue injection-molded panel cradles, rounded thick blue sidewalls, inset white name strips, recessed mango and blue score tiles, raised lime primary buttons with blue bold lettering and small sharp contact shadows. The same superb rounded geometric heavy typography, bevel widths, soft highlights, and bright tropical resort 3D art quality. Sky blue #69C9F4, royal blue #2940BD, mango #FFBE44, lime #CAEE62, warm white #FAFCFF. Same recognizable blonde visor toy athlete white polo navy shorts. Warm sunny miniature sports park. Joy comes from rich world, expressive hero, and materials, not slogans. This must look like more screens from the EXACT SAME game pictured in reference. Do not substitute flat CSS cards, Arial headings, glass panels, generic mobile UI, pastel clay blobs, or a different hero. UI should be impeccably aligned, readable from couch, uncluttered; molded depth not inflated bubbly buttons. Crisp legible copy exactly as requested. No marketing slogans, no monetization, no ultimate abilities, no ranked. Do not show or redesign a serve timing meter anywhere. Four distinct screens as follows:
TOP LEFT Title screen: island panoramic scene with same logo "ISLAND SPORTS CLUB", hero on right, one raised lime "PLAY" button low center; small "Settings" icon bottom right.
TOP RIGHT Home: exact hero centerpiece on right standing on same royal blue podium; left main action stack large "PLAY", then white "CAMPAIGN", "LOCKER", "SETTINGS". Logo top left. Show small friendly nameplate "ADNAN", nothing else.
BOTTOM LEFT Select sport: title "SELECT A SPORT", two large beautiful dimensional scenic tiles "TENNIS" (blue resort court) and "GOLF" (sunny putting green), selected tennis lime edge; bottom "CONTINUE" lime and white "BACK".
BOTTOM RIGHT Tennis hub: title "TENNIS"; hero holding racket on right, left tactile menu "QUICK MATCH", "CAMPAIGN", "TRAINING", white "BACK". Same reference materials and hero, clean copy.
